short: A long-lasting federal alliance of Boeotian cities dominated by Thebes, briefly elevating Thebes to the premier power in Greece.
full:
Formed in the sixth century BCE, the League united the agriculturally rich region of Boeotia under Theban leadership. It went through several constitutional iterations, typically functioning as an oligarchy where member cities contributed proportionally to a federal army and a central council. The League was briefly dissolved following the Persian Wars due to Theban collaboration with the invaders.

Reformed along more democratic lines in the fourth century, the League reached its zenith under the leadership of Epaminondas and Pelopidas. By decisively defeating Sparta at Leuctra in 371 BCE, the Boeotian League established a decade of Theban hegemony over Greece. It was later subdued by Macedon, and finally dissolved by Rome following the Third Macedonian War in 171 BCE.
